skill_name: Write a short narrative from the perspective of a person whose hobby is collecting stamps.
workflow: My passion for collecting stamps started when I was 8 years old. My father had given me my first stamp collection and I soon became obsessed with the variety of colors, designs and stories that each stamp contained. I started to research the histories and stories of each stamp in order to find out more information and uncover secrets behind them.
